researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Fully opened 2026 UCAS degree-award instructions specify doctoral original thesis submission, outside expert review and formal defense committee requirements under the common UCAS graduate-degree process.

programmes.school: 中国科学院数学与系统科学研究院 (AMSS)
programmes.evidence: Fully opened UCAS 2027 doctoral admission-unit catalogue explicitly lists subject code 120100 管理科学与工程 (Management Science and Engineering) with separate numbered full-time directions under AMSS. This is an exact official subject title, not a generic management topic.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Fully opened current UCAS doctoral award instructions require a thesis, expert review and defense under the university degree system.

limitations: Actual count relationship to the separately coded 1201Z1 Management Operations Research specialty should not be treated as separate graduate counts.

programmes.programName: 博士招生专业 1201Z1 管理运筹学
programmes.school: 中国科学院数学与系统科学研究院 (AMSS)
programmes.evidence: Fully opened UCAS 2027 AMSS doctoral catalogue lists formal code 1201Z1 管理运筹学 (Management Operations Research) as a separate doctoral admissions heading after code 120100, with its own numbered optimisation/decision direction. The page does not identify 1201Z1 as a child of 120100 or prove a separate degree parchment; record the exact code without asserting a parent relationship.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Fully opened 2026 UCAS degree-process source requires thesis, expert review and doctoral defense.

limitations: Separate formal admissions code and subject title, but no evidence here that its students or awarded degree are disjoint from the 120100 Management Science and Engineering category; do not add their graduate counts.

branches.conclusion: The fully opened AMSS 2027 doctoral catalogue confirms 120100 Management Science and Engineering plus 1201Z1 Management Operations Research. Other UCAS management-school formal subjects and quantitative area inventory were not fully read, so current scope remains partial.

The full AMSS doctoral catalogue confirms 070105 Operations Research and Control Theory. UCAS has other CAS institute training units not inventoried here, and no separate Industrial Engineering claim is made.
